digest.component_or_area: live Jira Cloud S3-backed reconciler test suite
propositions: Read-only S3-backed live Jira Cloud multi-project reconciler test suite must cover real Cloud projects REB and DIG with real ticket volume and diversity, using only proven non-mutating read paths (compute_snapshot and bridge_preview in dry-run mode).
The test suite must structurally enforce read-only semantics by monkeypatching all 18 mutating AcliClient methods to raise JiraWriteForbidden, preventing accidental Jira writes.
Per-project Jira issue counts must remain identical before and after all Jira-touching scenarios, serving as a belt-and-braces validation that no mutations occurred.
The suite must use an isolated S3-backed store with a throwaway prefix as the only remote, ensuring it cannot reach production and is cleaned up after teardown.
Unmapped or unknown Cloud projects must fail closed (raise) during snapshot computation rather than silently succeeding with empty results.
